verdict.rationale: Calendly documents a REST-based API v2 with resource-oriented URLs (calendly-docs-52). It covers creating event types via `POST /event_types` (calendly-docs-45), reading event-type availability through /event_type_available_times (calendly-docs-24, calendly-docs-75), and booking meetings end-to-end via the Scheduling API (calendly-docs-6, calendly-docs-1). PAT/OAuth auth, scopes and Free-plan API access make it usable inside third-party products, and a community developer reports building a client scheduling integration on Calendly (calendly-comm-11). Missing for 10: documented write/management of availability schedules (only read access is evidenced), documented update/cancel/reschedule of bookings via the API, and hands-on corroboration of event-type management depth.
